deployment.description: Free-text label of the deployment this binding describes.

tool.description: What the host invokes: an MCP server/tool, a CLI, an endpoint.

data_sources.description: required_data_sources name (as written in playbook frontmatter) -> available to the executor

data_source_notes.description: required_data_sources name -> why it is unavailable or limited; printed with the visibility gap

source_profiles.description: source identifier -> the source profile of that technology (a path next to the binding file, or into a tool skill). A profile says what the source's records mean in the framework's terms; it is validated against source_profile.schema.json. A deployment that names none has no profile, which is a visibility gap and not an error.
